title: Just another 'As seen on TV' gimmick
text: Just another 'As seen on TV' gimmick. I normally don't use nonstick (with the exception of one pan for eggs and grilled cheese) nor do i use aluminum cookware as it is harder to maintain a constant and even temperature but this was given to me as a gift. As soon as i laid eyes on it i can tell it was cheaply made and extremely overpriced. I put my initial feelings aside and decided to use it. It was used 3 times for light cooking, never on high heat, then the the bottom began to bulge and the pan would no longer sit flat on it's bottom. I turned the pan upside down on the counter and gave it a firm hit with my palm and flattened it back out! This is a testament as to how cheap and flimsy it is. If you must have a nonstick pan, buy a better brand, take care of it and it will last longer and perform better than this 'as seen on TV' nonsense.

Red Copper Square Pan 5 Piece Set includes 10-inch square pan, vented tempered glass lid, fry basket, steamer and roaster rack, and recipe guide
description: Bulky specialty pans take up tons of space in your cabinets. The Red Copper Square Pan 5 Piece Set is a one-pan solution to cooking 8 different ways, essentially clearing your cabinets of unnecessary clutter. Bake a decadent lasagna, then broil for a crisped cheesy perfection! Sauté your favorite stir fry, steam dumplings, braise meats, fry cutlets, deep fry tempura veggies, and roast a ham and veggies. Thanks to the square design, the 10-inch pan up to doubles your cooking area. Made from copper-infused ceramic, Red Copper Square Pan has a nonstick and scratch-resistant cooking surface. When seasoned properly, everything slides right out of the pan. There’s no need to use extra oil, butter, or grease.

Red Copper cookware does not contain any PFOAs or PTFEs. These chemicals are normally added to nonstick cookware, but begin to disintegrate at high heats. This causes the coating to flake off into food and potentially ingested. This Red Copper pan is oven safe up to 500-degrees Fahrenheit. Easily transition from stovetop to oven! The built-in helper handle makes carrying heavier dishes easy.

To ensure you get the most out of your Red Copper pan, an initial seasoning is required prior to use. Instructions are included. Occasional seasoning may be required for maintenance and optimal performance. Pan should be hand-washed in warm water with mild soap and towel dried.
Start cooking with the multipurpose Red Copper Square Pan set!
